get.description: Retrieves statistics for a lemlist campaign.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: The ID of the campaign to inspect.

schema.description: The ID of the campaign to inspect.

parameters.description: The start of the reporting range in ISO 8601 format.

schema.description: The start of the reporting range in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The end of the reporting range in ISO 8601 format.

schema.description: The end of the reporting range in ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: sendUser
parameters.description: Filter statistics to a specific sending user.

schema.description: Filter statistics to a specific sending user.

parameters.name: abSelected
parameters.description: Return statistics for only the A or B branch.

schema.description: Return statistics for only the A or B branch.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.description: A JSON array string of channels to include.

schema.description: A JSON array string of channels to include.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

nbLeads.description: Total leads in the campaign during the selected range.

nbLeadsLaunched.description: Leads launched during the selected range.
